title: Ravioli Skillet Bake with Kidney Beans, Mushrooms & Zucchini

steps.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and ravioli, and stir for a few seconds. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, mushrooms, Italian seasoning, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and medium dice zucchini.
When the veggies are soft, add zucchini to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 2-3 minutes more.
While the zucchini is cooking, drain and rinse beans in a colander.
Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons.

When the veggies are done, add the beans, half of the basil, and marinara sauce to the skillet. Stir to combine and continue to cook until warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
Add ravioli to the skillet, stir to combine, and sprinkle with cheese. Place in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide ravioli bake between plates or bowls and sprinkle with reserved basil. Enjoy!
